capabilities: Count syllables with full scansion breakdown
Suggest and rate rhymes by quality
Check poems against fixed verse forms
Look up synonyms, antonyms, and definitions
Draw rare words and thematic vocabulary
disambiguation: Despite 'carnet' (notebook), it is a French versification and vocabulary tool, not a general note-taking app.
extras: Interface and content are entirely in French. Free and open-source (GPL-3.0); the base dictionary is CC BY-SA 4.0. On first launch it downloads a ~1.9 MB phonetic dictionary from GitHub, its only automatic network access. Online sources are third-party sites without a public API contract and may break; all core features work offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for French versification, so poets must count syllables, find rhymes, and check forms in separate apps.

relations.evidence: The portal's internal JSON API: seven dictionaries (TLFi, Wiktionnaire, Académie 9th/8th/4th, Littré, DMF)
Its API: "Synonymes"/"Antonymes" sections; related vocabulary, derived words
Université de Caen's Dictionnaire Électronique des Synonymes, tens of thousands of curated entries
The LIRMM's crowd-built, weighted lexical network (associated ideas, characteristics, parts), sorted by weight
A French rhyming dictionary with IPA transcriptions

summary: French verse companion that counts syllables, finds and rates rhymes, and checks poems against fixed forms, working offline.
